full_judgment:
A.K.M. Asaduzzaman, J. This rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused petitioners should not be enlarged on bail in Zinaigati G.R. Case No.65 of 09 corresponding to Zinaigati P.S. Case No.09 dated 23.07.2009 under section 143/148/ 323/ 307/302/114/34 of the Penal Code, now pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sherpur. 

 Prosecution case, in short is that one Md. Ismail Hossain filed a petition of complain being Petition Case No.08 of 2009 on 19.7.09 before the Judicial Magistrate, Sherpur against the 12 persons under sections 143/148/ 323/ 307/302/114/34 of the Penal Code alleging inter alia that two days before the date of occurrence accused No.7 was married and younger brother of the informant Nurul Amin attend in the said marriage and next day accused No.1 announced that deceased Nurul Amin told a false and malicious statement about wife of accused No.7 and after knowing some accused came at the informant’s house and told abuse terms and at one time a scuffle was hold between the same accused and younger brother of informant and deceased Nurul Amin after that some time before the occurrence accused no.3 came at the informant’s house and brought to the deceased Nurul Amin for compromise and when the Nurul Amin arrived southern side adjacent to the house of the accused no.1 then all the accused surrounded to the deceased and on command of the accused no.1 the accused no.2 beat by bamboo on the head of the deceased and when deceased lay down then accused Mominul Haque locate by ‘Lathi’ on left leg and accused Mohammad Ali, Hossain Ali and Abdul Majid also heat by ‘Kathi’ and when Nurul Amin shouting then witnesses nos.1 to 3 went to the place of occurrence for saving the deceased but accused No.4 beat to witness No.1 by Lathi’ and also accused no.6 beat to the witness no.2 by ‘Lathi’ accused no.3 also beat to the witnesses no.3 as well as accused no.7 beat by the ‘Lathi’ on the hand of the witness no.3 accused no.9 beat to the informant by ‘Lathi’ and accused no.12 threatened to the informant by “Dao” and when the others witnesses came at the place of occurrence then all the accused leave the place of occurrence and thereafter the informant brought the deceased at Zinaigati Hospital but as per advice of the doctor further brought at Sherpur Sadar Hospital and one day after further brought at Mymensingh Medical College Hospital but doctor further send to Dhaka Medical College Hospital where on 15.07.2009 Nurul Amin had died.
